newsitem.title: USA: Millennium sees Q1 charge from acquistion.
newsitem.headline: Millennium sees Q1 charge from acquistion.

text.p: Millennium Pharmaceuticals Inc said on Tuesday it would take a substantial charge in the first quarter, due a write-off related to its merger with ChemGenics Pharmaceuticals Inc.

The company said it had completed the merger, which would be treated as a purchase for accounting purposes. But it said it would take a charge against first quarter operating results for the write-off of acquired in-process research and development.

Under the merger terms, 0.2374 shares of common Millennium stock were exchanged for each outstanding ChemGenics share, the company said. Millennium issued about 4.8 million shares of common stock in exchange for all outstanding shares of common stock of ChemGenics.
Millennium employs large-scale genetics, genomics, screening and bioinformatics in an integrated drug discovery program applicable to all major human diseases.
